description: This file defines a state management store for a game using the Zustand library. It initializes default game settings, loads persisted data, and provides functions to update the game state, such as player info, equations, bounds, and leaderboard management.

methods.name: setPlayerName
methods.description: Updates the player's name in the game store and persists the change.

methods.name: setEquations
methods.description: Sets new equations in the store and persists the changes.

methods.name: setBounds
methods.description: Updates the game bounds configuration and saves it.

methods.name: setDt
methods.description: Sets the delta time value for simulation steps and saves.

methods.name: setSpeed
methods.description: Adjusts the game speed and persists the change.

methods.name: setDifficulty
methods.description: Changes the game difficulty setting and saves.

methods.name: setSamples
methods.description: Updates the number of samples and saves.

methods.name: addLeaderboard
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the leaderboard, sorts, and trims the leaderboard list.

methods.name: compileEquations
methods.description: Compiles the current set of equations using an external parser function.
